name: A Roof for Every Size
jem_summary: Place a small or large animal home.

pages.title: A Roof for Every Size
pages.text: Place a small or large animal home.

pages.title: A Roof for Every Size
pages.text: Give a companion a return point; the two sizes are appearance choices.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Small: slabs, planks and logs. Large: stairs, planks and logs. Use one matching vanilla wood family. Either home accepts a supported animal of any hitbox size.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Small uses slabs/logs/planks; large uses stairs/logs/planks from one vanilla wood family. Both accept any supported animal size.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Hitbox size does not block binding; safe nearby placement uses full creature clearance around home level, including a surface above a buried home.
